title: Harness smoke test: sky130 models in ngspice via xschem
claim: Harness bring-up only -- NOT a spec claim. Substantiates that the pinned sky130 PDK models load in ngspice, that xschem netlists to a deck the runner can drive, and that the process/voltage/temperature knobs measurably change the result. Spec-line claims live in their own experiment directories once spec/ is ratified (see issue #1).
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: vgs
measurements.note: Gate-source voltage of the diode-connected nfet_g5v0d10v5. Wide window on purpose: this is a harness liveness bound, not a spec limit.

measurements.name: isup
measurements.note: Supply current, ~(vsup - vgs)/1Mohm. Positive-into-the-circuit sign convention.

spread_checks.note: Guards against a silently corner-blind harness: if every corner returns the same vgs, the .lib/.temp injection is not taking effect.
